references.text: The golden bowls used in the tabernacle are described here, including bowls for incense.
The regulation for the holy incense that was to be filled into the golden bowls at the consecration.
Bezalel made the golden bowls for the tabernacle that were used in the offering service.
The first time the golden bowl with incense is mentioned in this offering list, at Nahshon's gift.
The summary of all twelve golden bowls filled with incense that were given by the tribal leaders.
Golden bowls filled with incense represent the prayers of the saints in the heavenly sanctuary.
Incense in golden bowls is offered at the heavenly altar together with the prayers of the saints.
